title: Termwise scalar-extension adjunction on ringed-site complexes
statement: For a morphism phi:R -> B of commutative ring sheaves on a small site, the sheafified scalar-extension adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus] induces an adjunction between termwise scalar extension and termwise restriction on unbounded integer cochain complexes. Scalar extension is additive. This is the specified adjunction obtained by applying Adjunction.mapHomologicalComplex, not an arbitrary witness of existence.

proof.text: Restriction of scalars is additive; Mathlib Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive makes its specified left adjoint additive.
Apply the existing termwise adjunction construction to shape up Z. The definition retains the actual unit, counit and hom equivalence of that construction.

def ringedScalarExtensionComplexAdjunction
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ B) :
    (SheafOfModules.RingedTensor.tensorFunctor φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⊣
      (SheafOfModules.RingedTensor.restriction φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
